      U2iResponse USB_I2C_BridgeImpl.enableVccOut​(VCC_STATE aVccState)
      Only applicable for Pololu Isolated USB-to-I2C Adapter with Isolated Power
      U2iResponse USB_I2C_BridgeImpl.i2cRead​(int aAddress, byte[] aBuffer)
      Read aBuffer.length bytes from the I2C device with address aAddress.
      The data read are placed in the given buffer.
      U2iResponse USB_I2C_BridgeImpl.i2cRead​(int aAddress, byte[] aBuffer, int aOffset, int aLength)
      Read aLength bytes from the I2C device with address aAddress and stores them in the buffer, placing the first byte at aOffset.
      Furthermore a U2iResponse object is set up with the status informations of the command execution.
      U2iResponse USB_I2C_BridgeImpl.i2cWrite​(int aAddress, byte[] aBuffer)
      Writes aBuffer.length bytes to the I2C device with address aAddress.
      Furthermore a U2iResponse object is created and set up with the status of the operation execution.
      U2iResponse USB_I2C_BridgeImpl.i2cWrite​(int aAddress, byte[] aBuffer, int aOffset, int aLength)
      Writes aLength bytes from aBuffer, starting at location aOffset to the I2C device with address aAddress. .
      Furthermore a U2iResponse object is set up with the status informations of the command execution.
      U2iResponse USB_I2C_BridgeImpl.i2cWriteRead​(int aAddress, byte[] aWriteBuffer, byte[] aReadBuffer)
      Performs a w/r operation on the I2C bus with a repeated start condition.
